# Manual test: Brightwater Tile & Stone in Duracash

A step-by-step script for testing Duracash by hand with the fictional contractor in
`company.md`. Each step has a checkbox and the result you should see. Button and field names are
copied from the app (`static/app.js`). The steps were last walked against the code on 2026-11-05, parts 0, 2, 4, 5
and the money in 6 against a running server through the same API calls the buttons make.

When a result differs, note the step number and what you saw. Known app problems are in
`APP-ISSUES.md`; don't re-report those.

## 0. Set up (5 minutes)

- [ ] 0.1 Start a server with throwaway data, from the repo folder. The loader's jobs bill in dollars, as jobs from before Nov 3 do, and New job now gives every job a schedule of values, so this first server makes jobs the older way (`tests/dollar_jobs.py`):
      `DURACASH_DATA_DIR=/tmp/bd-test BACKUP_HOURS=0 PORT=8791 python3 -c "import sys, runpy; sys.path.insert(0, 'tests'); import domain, dollar_jobs; domain.create_job = dollar_jobs._older_job; runpy.run_path('server.py', run_name='__main__')"`
      Use an empty folder for `DURACASH_DATA_DIR`: `rm -rf /tmp/bd-test` first if you have run this before.
- [ ] 0.2 In a second terminal: `python3 scripts/load_test_contractor.py --base http://127.0.0.1:8791 --only-setup`
      Expected: it ends with `58 of 59 checks passed.` and one `FAILED` line, "MILL: draft waits on the waiver and insurance certificate only": that check in the loader is older than the Daily tickets and time sheets item, which 1.2 expects. It prints an email and password, also saved in `testdata/test-contractor/.login` (git-ignored).
      `--only-setup` stops before the imports, so you do the imports by hand in part 3.
- [ ] 0.2a Stop the server (Ctrl+C) and start it the normal way on the same data, for everything from here on, so new jobs behave as they do for a real company:
      `DURACASH_DATA_DIR=/tmp/bd-test BACKUP_HOURS=0 PORT=8791 python3 server.py`
- [ ] 0.3 Open http://127.0.0.1:8791, choose **Sign in** (a browser that has signed in before opens there), and use the email and password from `.login`.
      Expected: Dashboard opens for "Brightwater Tile & Stone LLC".
      Before signing in, the landing shows **Look around a sample company** under the pitch (the test server has the demo company). It opens the demo's Dashboard without a password; **Log out** brings you back. Don't change anything there.

Email is not set up on a test server, so every send ends with a toast like
"Saved. The email to ap@... was not sent: email delivery is not set up." That is expected: the
pay app is still marked sent, and the Outbox lists the email. Dashboard lists each of those that still matters (job open, pay app unpaid) at the top
as **Didn't go out** with **Send Again**, the Dashboard menu item shows how many, and the pay app's row
on its job page reads "sent <date> · email failed".

## 1. Look around (what the loader built)

- [ ] 1.1 **Jobs > Open jobs** lists 8 jobs: ASHB, BROO, DECA, GLEN, KENN, MILL, VEST, WHIT. Under the list: "1 closed job is under Job history." (PEAC).
- [ ] 1.2 Open **Mill Creek Clubhouse**. Status pill **Needs supporting documents** (amber, not red), primary button **Add 3 missing documents**. The Schedule of values card shows 5 lines and a $80,300.00 contract. PA-MILL-01 is a Draft for $33,042.90.
- [ ] 1.3 Open **Decatur Library Annex**. Money shows $6,400.00 retainage open; PA-DECA-01 is Paid.
- [ ] 1.4 **Jobs > Client playbook** shows 6 clients. Open **Tallow Creek Builders**: **Days between follow-ups** 5, **Pay apps due by** 25, **Days they usually take to pay** 18, **Also email (CC)** pm@tallowcreekbuilders.example. On a phone the labels have no (i); the card ends with **What do these mean?**, which lists each box with its explanation.
- [ ] 1.5 **Dashboard** > To Do: Mill Creek Clubhouse shows its first blocker and **Add 3 missing documents**. Within 5 days before the 25th (the cutoff), Kennesaw Ortho Clinic shows "Due soon" with **Progress Pay App** and the cutoff date, and Mill Creek's blocked row ends with "Pay app due to Tallow Creek Builders by <the 25th>." and moves up: its PA-MILL-01 is only a draft, so this cycle is not billed yet. Above them, each unpaid pay app and each waiver the loader sent shows **Didn't go out** ("<subject> to <email>: not sent: email delivery is not set up") with **Send Again**. To Do shows three rows, then **and N more**; tapping it shows the rest until you leave Dashboard.

## 3. Imports

Files are in `testdata/test-contractor/import/` and `bad/`. Upload on **Import/Export > Import** with **Choose files**
(or drag the file onto the page), with **Which job?** left at **Not sure, file later** so the
matching is what is tested. The cards are in **Communications > Inbox**. After each upload the card appears under **Waiting (N)** with
"Suggested because it ..." and one button **Add to <job>** (with **Other job** and **Change type (<kind>)**
beside it), or, with no suggestion, a job and kind select. Don't file yet unless the step says so.

- [ ] 4.1 Open **Kirkwood Dental Suite** > **Progress Pay App**.
